<!--
The PR TITLE must follow Conventional Commits — it becomes the squash-merge commit on `main`
and drives the version bump + changelog. Examples:
  feat: add Tailwind v4 exporter      → minor
  fix: clamp K-Means seeds to bounds  → patch
  feat!: drop the net6.0 target       → major (breaking)
  chore: tidy usings                  → no release
See CONTRIBUTING.md → "Commit messages".
-->

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated for new behavior
- [ ] New/changed public APIs are documented
